global_events: Fifteen current official August 2026 records were decided; twelve selected and three fail-closed.
Savills and Auction House UK official sources were both retained in this batch.
Four Savills catalogue-plus-detail and eight Auction House full-direct source upgrades were retained.
All retained candidates have future 3–18 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.
Fifteen representative exact-address repository searches returned zero indexed hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
103 Field Lane was excluded because its full official page returned a cache miss.
Apartment 167 City Point was excluded because its full official page returned a cache miss.
47 Argyll Road was excluded because the current page exposed insufficient property, tenure and occupancy detail.
Savills guide prices were taken from the current 18 August catalogue and property attributes from corresponding full-detail pages.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rent, licence, tenancy, guarantee and investment wording was not independently underwritten.
Lease, title, VAT, charges, parking, barns, outbuildings, converted-building and common-part obligations remain legal-pack dependent.
Planning permission, pre-planning advice, listed-building and alternative-use wording was not converted into verified planning outcomes.
Hailsham Drive planning and S106 statements require authority and legal-pack verification.
Westend Farm, Pant Einion Hall and Gorphwysfa listed or historic status requires legal and authority verification.
Derelict, renovation, modernisation, measurements, services and condition wording requires professional inspection.
Vacancy, no-onward-chain, possession and occupational status require legal-pack confirmation.
Approximate site, floor and land areas were not independently surveyed.
Current official catalogue and lot pages were used; stale or inaccessible detail was not silently expanded.
No second runner, owner or task was created; continuation key was preserved.
Research was split across four bounded source groups while GitHub writes remained serial.
Wave, progress, web, report, validation and state files require final publication readback.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Public-host, parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence was created.
